description: Turn client proposals, briefs, scopes and kickoff notes into a tailored onboarding plan and evidence-based readiness audit. The plugin separates confirmed facts from assumptions, identifies missing assets, content, access, approvals, owners, dates, dependencies and blockers, calculates a readiness score, and prepares a client-ready request. It does not send messages, create ChasePad records, or store source documents in analytics.

defaultPrompt: Check whether this client project is ready for kickoff.
Turn this client brief into a tailored onboarding plan.
Draft a client-ready request for everything still missing.
